evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.4 ppm at the beginning of settled growth.
Exhaust oxygen increased to 14.6 ppm with unchanged growth setpoints.
Exhaust oxygen continued rising to 26.2 ppm, departing from the preceding approximately 4–6 ppm baseline.
Temperature is 750.0 °C and argon flow 99.8 sccm, close to setpoints; controller reports running despite the oxygen trend.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the stated growth-stage pressure requirement.

args.missing_evidence: Verified tube pressure and independent oxygen measurement, followed by gas-purity, leak and exhaust-path checks, are needed to establish the cause of the oxygen rise; sample characterization is not yet available.
